module: Node "Get Variable" (provider, hidden from the menus: created from the variable editor). Exposes a graph or project variable ("Use Project as Source" checkbox) on an output pin bearing its name and type. Handles renaming and type changes while keeping compatible links.
notes: Bug: globalColor = im.ImVec4(1,0.6,0,8,0.75) has 5 arguments ("0,8" instead of "0.8"): the last one is ignored, alpha = 8.
work fails if varName is nil (no variable chosen).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: varName = nil, global = false, target = graph variables.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Scope checkbox, variable list and variable editor.

setGlobal.desc: Changes the scope (project/graph), the node color and removes the current pin.

setVar.desc: Chooses the variable: recreates the output pin with the right type and redoes the compatible links.

renameVariable.desc: Hook: updates the node and pin name if the tracked variable is renamed.

typeUpdated.desc: Hook: recreates the pin when the variable's type changes.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.
